name: That Shadowvale Green Elixir
summary: In Brill, Carolai Anise seeks bottles of Shadowvale's green elixir. The secluded village once distilled Whispering Elixir from local herbs, and buyers still prize the banned brew.

sections.title: A Banned Brew
sections.body: Before the Scourge came, Shadowvale's secluded villagers brewed Whispering Elixir from rare herbs found only in Tirisfal Glades. The draught became known across northern Lordaeron. Though the Capital City outlawed it, mystics, poisoners, and apothecaries still sought its unusual properties, even at the risk of defying royal decrees.

sections.title: Ruins in the Whispering Forest
sections.body: Shadowvale lies deep in the Whispering Forest of western Tirisfal. Its people were insular and distrustful, and rarely welcomed outsiders. The Scourge invasion left the settlement in ruins, but forgotten stores of aged green elixir remain among the wreckage. Carolai Anise works from Brill, where she answers the underworld's lasting demand by paying adventurers willing to brave the forest's unsettling silence.

sections.title: The Whispering Curse
sections.body: Carolai Anise dismisses the rumors as superstition, but the Whispering Forest has a dark reputation. Local lore says an ancient curse taints the soil and roots, and seeps into the plants Shadowvale's brewers harvested. Whatever malevolence lingers around the abandoned hamlet, distant buyers still hunger for its bottled remnants.

faq.answer: Shadowvale was a secluded village deep in the Whispering Forest of western Tirisfal Glades. Its secretive people distilled rare brews from local herbs before the Scourge overran the region.
Whispering Elixir is a potent green draught brewed from herbs found only in Tirisfal. Mystics, poisoners, and apothecaries sought it, though the Capital City outlawed it before Lordaeron fell.

aliases: who gives that shadowvale green elixir quest
faq.answer: Carolai Anise is a Forsaken resident of Brill. She brokers valuable banned curios, including Shadowvale's elixir, for buyers across the realm.

faq.q: Why was the elixir banned in the Capital City?
faq.answer: No reason for the ban is given. Carolai says only that the elixir was outlawed in the city, though apothecaries, mystics, and poisoners sought it. Some blame a curse in the Whispering Forest and its roots, but Carolai dismisses that as superstition and never links it to the ban.

faq.q: Why is the Whispering Forest considered dangerous?
faq.answer: The secluded woods west of Deathknell are considered eerie and cursed. Those who venture there speak of deep malevolence and strange woodland phenomena, and rumors say the forest's soil tainted its herbs.

faq.q: Who are the buyers wanting this elixir?
faq.answer: Carolai Anise says several buyers seek surviving bottles from before the war, but she does not name them.

angles.text: For you among the Forsaken, recovering Lordaeron's forgotten brews can bring profit and fuel apothecary experiments in the fledgling Undercity.
As a rogue, you know Whispering Elixir was prized by poisoners and scoundrels who worked beyond the notice of Lordaeron's former magistrates.
As a herbalist, you know the elixir draws its potency from rare herbs that grow only beneath the Whispering Forest's eerie canopy.
